# Artifact Contract schema reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-artifact-contract-reference.mjs. Do not edit directly. -->

A portable interpretation sidecar that keeps an information artifact's purpose, claims, evidence, time, reception, accountability, and preservation requirements inspectable across interfaces.

- Contract version: `0.1`
- JSON Schema: `spec/v0.1/artifact-contract.schema.json`
- Stable schema identifier: `https://semiotic.dev/spec/v0.1/artifact-contract.schema.json`
- Unknown, manual, and not-applicable states remain distinct; absence is never reported as a successful check.
- Core objects reject unknown keys. Domain-specific additions belong in the top-level `extensions` object.
